name: ixa-ro
description: Search products, compare store prices in RON, and find recent price drops across Romanian online stores monitored by IXA.RO.

interface.longDescription:
IXA.RO helps people shopping online in Romania compare prices for products sold by the Romanian online stores that IXA.RO monitors. All prices are in Romanian lei (RON).

What you can do:
- Search the IXA.RO catalog by product name, optionally filtered by a price range in RON and sorted by price.
- Compare the current offers for a product across monitored stores, including each store's price, when that price was last updated, and the lowest available price.
- See whether a product's current price is a recent drop compared with its historical average, and search for products with recent price drops.
- Paste a product link from a monitored store (for example emag.ro, altex.ro or pcgarage.ro) to find the matching IXA.RO price comparison.

Limitations:
- Only stores monitored by IXA.RO are covered. The list is published at https://ixa.ro/despre.
- The catalog uses Romanian product names, so searches work best with Romanian terms or with brand and model names.
- Prices come from the stores and can change after the last update. Check the final price on the store's website before buying.
- IXA.RO does not sell products, take orders or process payments. Offer links open the store's own website through an IXA.RO redirect, and IXA.RO may earn an affiliate commission from some stores.
- Price alerts, wishlists and price history charts are available on ixa.ro but not through this plugin.
- No account or sign-in is required.
defaultPrompt: Compare store prices for the iPhone 17 Pro 256GB Cosmic Orange.
Find a Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra priced between 3000 and 6000 lei, cheapest first.
Are there any recent price drops on vacuum cleaners (aspiratoare)?

positive.description: Search the catalog by product name and show lowest prices.
positive.prompt: Find iPhone 17 Pro phones on IXA.RO and show their lowest prices.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_products with a query such as 'iphone 17 pro' and lists matching iPhone 17 Pro models with each model's lowest price in RON and a link to its IXA.RO comparison page. No prices are invented.

positive.description: Compare the current store offers for one specific product.
positive.prompt: Compare store prices for the iPhone 17 Pro 256GB Cosmic Orange.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the product with search_products, then calls get_product_prices with its 10-character productId and shows each monitored store's offer (store, price in RON, last update date), the lowest price, and links to the offers.

positive.description: Filter search results by a price range in RON and sort by ascending price.
positive.prompt: Find a Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra priced between 3000 and 6000 lei, cheapest first.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_products with minPrice 3000, maxPrice 6000 and sortBy 'price_asc', then lists only Galaxy S24 Ultra phones whose lowest price is within 3000-6000 RON, in ascending price order, with IXA.RO links.

positive.description: Find products with a recent price drop compared with their historical average.
positive.prompt: Are there any recent price drops on vacuum cleaners (aspiratoare)?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_recent_discounts with a Romanian query such as 'aspirator' and lists products whose price recently dropped, with the current lowest price in RON and an IXA.RO link. If nothing matches, it says so instead of inventing deals.

positive.description: Look up the IXA.RO price comparison from a product link on a monitored store.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_product_by_store_url with the link, matches the iPhone 17 Pro 256GB Cosmic Orange on IXA.RO, and reports the store offers, the lowest price in RON, when each price was last updated, and whether the current price is a recent best price.

negative.description: Purchases and payments are out of scope. IXA.RO only compares prices; it cannot place orders or handle card details. Expected: no purchase is attempted and no payment details are requested; the assistant may offer a price comparison and a link to the store's website.
negative.prompt: Buy the cheapest iPhone 17 Pro for me and pay with my saved card.

negative.description: Price alerts need an ixa.ro account and no plugin tool creates them. Expected: the assistant explains that alerts are not available through the plugin and can be set up on ixa.ro, and does not claim that an alert was created.
negative.prompt: Email me when the Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra drops below 4000 lei.

negative.description: Stores outside IXA.RO's monitored Romanian stores are not covered. Expected: if get_product_by_store_url is called it returns a 'store not monitored' message; the assistant says the store is not covered and does not invent a price.
negative.prompt: Check the price of this product: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0CHX1W1XY

review.commerce_description: IXA.RO does not sell products, take orders or process payments. It compares prices; offer links redirect to the third-party store's own website, where any purchase happens. IXA.RO may earn an affiliate commission from some stores.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: product search with optional RON price range and price sorting, store-by-store price comparison, search for recent price drops, and lookup from a monitored store's product link.

ro-RO.subtitle: Compară prețuri în România
ro-RO.description:
IXA.RO te ajută să compari prețurile produselor vândute de magazinele online din România monitorizate de IXA.RO. Toate prețurile sunt în lei (RON).

Ce poți face:
- Cauți produse în catalogul IXA.RO după nume, opțional cu un interval de preț în RON și sortare după preț.
- Compari ofertele actuale pentru un produs din magazinele monitorizate: prețul din fiecare magazin, când a fost actualizat și cel mai mic preț disponibil.
- Vezi dacă prețul actual al unui produs este o scădere recentă față de media istorică și cauți produse cu scăderi recente de preț.
- Lipești linkul unui produs de pe un magazin monitorizat (de exemplu emag.ro, altex.ro sau pcgarage.ro) ca să găsești compararea de prețuri IXA.RO.

Limitări:
- Sunt acoperite doar magazinele monitorizate de IXA.RO. Lista este publicată la https://ixa.ro/despre.
- Prețurile vin de la magazine și se pot schimba după ultima actualizare. Verifică prețul final pe site-ul magazinului înainte de cumpărare.
- IXA.RO nu vinde produse, nu preia comenzi și nu procesează plăți. Linkurile către oferte deschid site-ul magazinului printr-o redirecționare IXA.RO, iar IXA.RO poate primi un comision de afiliere de la unele magazine.
- Alertele de preț, lista de favorite și graficele de istoric de preț sunt disponibile pe ixa.ro, dar nu prin acest plugin.
- Nu este nevoie de cont sau autentificare.
